_comment: Machine-readable lock for Jaune's external bootstrap inputs. Consumed by scripts/env_doctor.py and (from Step 2 onward) the bootstrap tooling. Documented in scripts/vectors/SOURCES.md. Do not duplicate these literals elsewhere; update this file and let consumers read it.

execution_specs._comment: Legacy BlockchainTests fixtures live under <root>/tests/fixtures/ethereum_tests, an independent nested checkout (see ethereum_tests below), not an execution-specs submodule.

ethereum_tests._comment: Ignored by execution-specs' .gitignore; not tracked as a Git submodule of execution-specs.

eest._comment_env_var: EEST_ROOT names the top-level install directory containing the archive and its extracted fixtures/ tree. It is distinct from scripts/check.sh's JAUNE_FIXTURES, which instead points directly at a tier's leaf fixture directory (and already defaults to <EEST_ROOT>/fixtures/blockchain_tests for --bls). The two variables are not interchangeable.
eest._comment_layout: Every member of the archive is a regular file whose path begins with the fixtures_subpath prefix, so extracting into <EEST_ROOT> yields <EEST_ROOT>/fixtures/. The archive contains no directory, symlink, hardlink, or special members; the safe extractor and deep verifier reject anything else.
eest._comment_metadata: Release-identity fields recorded inside the archive's own .meta/fixtures.ini ([fixtures] section). Fast-mode verification confirms the extracted tree carries this exact provenance; the values are pinned here rather than derived from release_tag because the upstream git ref (tests-v5.4.0) differs from the release download tag (v5.4.0).

current_mainnet._comment: The canonical current-mainnet lane. The GitHub release API resolves this immutable target commit and uploaded asset digest; the archive's .meta/index.json provides the independently checked fixture-tree root hash, generation time, and test count.

glamsterdam_devnet._comment: The Glamsterdam devnet-8 lane. A PRERELEASE fixture corpus (recorded 2026-09-04 as targeting a fork whose block rules this build did not implement, with every fixture suite over it refused and `Fork.amsterdam.rules?` `none`; goal C, 2026-09-06, composed `amsterdamRules` and activated the two static suites, retiring the separate t8n-only metering vehicle that had exercised the transaction semantics; goal jaune-amsterdam-currency-v1 activated the two transition-carrying suites by gating the BPO2-to-Amsterdam activation boundary). All four suites run; `Fork.amsterdam.rules?` resolves; the same commit is the transition-tool anchor below. The release commit is a merge of `forks/amsterdam` into `devnets/glamsterdam/8`, so the fixtures and the executable reference agree by construction, and `conformance_target` below is pinned to the same commit. Layout, top-level directories, and the `.meta/index.json` identity fields above were recorded from the checksum-verified archive on 2026-09-04 (moved from v8.1.3/8ca2f4c to v8.1.4/7341820), not assumed from the mainnet lane.
glamsterdam_devnet._comment_lane: This lane is separate from current_mainnet in every respect that could couple them: its own install root, env var, archive, manifest (scripts/amsterdam/manifests.json), suites, and exclusions. The mainnet lane's pin, manifest, suites, and baselines are not read or written by anything on this side.

conformance_target._comment: The transition-tool conformance anchor for `jaune t8n`, chosen 2026-08-03 because this checkout's `fill` defaults to the in-process ExecutionSpecsTransitionTool, which calls this same checkout's EELS in process (client_clis/__init__.py sets the default tool; clis/execution_specs.py runs T8N.run). It is a GATE ANCHOR, not a fork-scope commitment: `fork_lane` is the block-validation handshake advertised by `jaune t8n --forks`, while `--state.fork Amsterdam` resolves a separate transaction-metering vehicle and names its omitted block semantics through `--info`; no BPO3-5 path is selected. This checkout is SEPARATE from execution_specs above -- that one is the frozen oracle pin for check-fake-exp.sh and the vector generators, and is never repointed. This one has its own venv (`uv sync --no-default-groups --group test`), which scripts/gen-t8n-goldens.py and scripts/check-t8n.sh drive.
conformance_target._comment_repin: Moved 2026-09-03 from 9d6e6f8 (forks/amsterdam, 2026-08-10) to 8ca2f4c, the commit the tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.3 release was built from, so that the anchor and glamsterdam_devnet above name ONE revision. The old pin predates the EIP-8038 constant revision and was therefore stale on exactly the numbers scripts/check-fork-constants.sh reads. The nine Prague-lane goldens were regenerated at the new pin and required to be byte-identical; the wrapper commit was carried across as ed46609 (branch jaune-wrapper-8ca2f4c), whose diff against 8ca2f4c is exactly the four framework-side wrapper paths gen-t8n-goldens.py allows. The pre-move wrapper commit remains reachable as branch jaune-wrapper at 827a1ca. Moved again 2026-09-04 from 8ca2f4c to 7341820, the commit the tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.4 release was built from (owner decision 2026-09-04, recorded in jaune-amsterdam-metering-v1's 'Decisions at launch'), so that the anchor and glamsterdam_devnet above continue to name ONE revision. The module delta between the two pins is exactly one formula change under src/ethereum/forks/amsterdam -- #3478, 'repay spilled state gas from the reservoir when a child merges' (vm/gas.py's new repay_state_gas_spill, called from vm/__init__.py's incorporate_child on a successful child merge) -- and no constant moved (release note 'no repricing changes', confirmed by the diff, not merely trusted). The wrapper commit was carried across again as a new branch jaune-wrapper-7341820, cherry-picked from ed46609; jaune-wrapper-8ca2f4c and jaune-wrapper remain reachable and untouched.

python_oracle._comment: Python 3.11.9 is an exact requirement, not merely a 3.11-series preference: the oracle includes native extension wheels and its generated bytes are accepted only from the tested interpreter/package closure. The complete 18-package runtime closure is hash-locked in requirements_lock. execution-specs itself is intentionally absent from that lock; generators import from the separately manifest-pinned checkout, avoiding a machine-local path entry.
